evals.prompt: Add a strict CSP to our Next 16 app (cacheComponents: true): a per-request nonce in proxy.ts and script-src 'self' 'nonce-…' 'strict-dynamic'.
evals.expected_output: Should explain that a nonce needs the request's headers, which a Cache Components static shell doesn't have, so a nonce policy would make every page dynamic or break. Under Cache Components a strict script policy isn't available yet, and the house records script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' as a known gap. Every other directive stays strict (default-src 'self', object-src 'none', base-uri 'none', frame-ancestors 'none', explicit connect-src and img-src). 'unsafe-eval' never ships: local development gets it by branching on APP_ENV, never NODE_ENV. Roll out as Report-Only first.
expectations: Explains why a nonce conflicts with Cache Components
Records the script-src 'unsafe-inline' gap instead of shipping a broken nonce policy
Keeps 'unsafe-eval' out of production and branches on APP_ENV

evals.prompt: Show the user's bio, which is rich text saved from our editor: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: user.bio }} />.
evals.expected_output: Should render the HTML only through the one sanitising component (DOMPurify), the single place dangerouslySetInnerHTML appears, using the same allowlist policy the server applies when it saves rich text. SANITIZE_DOM stays on and SANITIZE_NAMED_PROPS is added against DOM clobbering, and the component never looks up user HTML by name.
expectations: Routes the HTML through the single sanitising component
Uses the same policy the server applies on save

evals.prompt: Our API client needs the session token. Store it in localStorage after sign-in and read it for each fetch.
evals.expected_output: Should refuse: the session is an httpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookie that only the API sets, so script, including injected script, can't read it. No token goes in localStorage or sessionStorage; a short-lived token a client SDK needs lives in memory only, and requests go same-origin with the cookie.
expectations: Rejects localStorage and sessionStorage for tokens
Uses the httpOnly session cookie set by the API
Keeps any short-lived SDK token in memory only

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md says: "apps/web is embedded by our partner at https://partner.example.com in an iframe (contract, 2026-05). The other apps are never framed." Add the security headers baseline to every app.
evals.expected_output: Should send the baseline from each app's next.config headers() on /:path*, written out in each app and changed together. apps/web allows only the named ancestor (frame-ancestors https://partner.example.com) and doesn't send X-Frame-Options: DENY, which would block the partner. Every other app sends frame-ancestors 'none' with X-Frame-Options: DENY. HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, CORP and poweredByHeader: false apply everywhere.
expectations: Puts the headers in each app's next.config headers()
Allows only the recorded partner origin as a frame ancestor for apps/web
Doesn't send X-Frame-Options: DENY on apps/web
Denies framing on the other apps
Includes the rest of the baseline (HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
